import sys
import logging
from dd4hep import compileAClick, enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo, DD4hepSimulation, _set, get_unbound_function, setPrintLevel, makeSet, setOption, setOptions, Geant4, __setMagneticFieldOptions, importConstants, printDetectors, _setKernelProperty, import_geometry, setDumpDetailedParticleInfo, show_help, get_code, is_package, CommandLine

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger("dd4hep_simulation")

def run_simulation():
    import argparse
    import os

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DD4hep Simulation Runner")
    parser.add_argument('--geometry', type=str, required=True, help='Path to the geometry file (XML)')
    parser.add_argument('--help', action='store_true', help='Show help message and exit')
    parser.add_argument('--events', type=int, default=10, help='Number of events to simulate')
    parser.add_argument('--print-level', type=int, default=logging.INFO, help='Set print/logging level')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.help:
        show_help()
        sys.exit(0)

    setPrintLevel(args.print_level)
    logger.info("Loading geometry from: %s", args.geometry)
    detector = import_geometry(args.geometry)

    logger.info("Importing constants...")
    importConstants(detector)

    logger.info("Setting up Geant4 simulation...")
    sim = DD4hepSimulation(detector)
    Geant4(sim)

    logger.info("Printing detectors...")
    printDetectors(detector)

    logger.info("Configuring UI, tracking field, and event actions...")
    setOption(sim, "UI", True)
    __setMagneticFieldOptions(sim, {"field": "Uniform", "value": [0, 0, 2.0]})
    setOption(sim, "EventActions", True)

    logger.info("Setting up particle gun...")
    setOption(sim, "ParticleGun", {"particle": "e-", "energy": 10.0, "direction": [0, 0, 1]})

    logger.info("Setting up tracker...")
    setOption(sim, "Tracker", True)

    logger.info("Building physics list...")
    setOption(sim, "PhysicsList", "FTFP_BERT")

    logger.info("Executing Geant4 simulation...")
    sim.run(args.events)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_simulation()
```
